estimated_cost_range_usd: $1,000-3,000 per retreat (3-7 days, all-inclusive in Peru/Ecuador)
access_pathway_details: Mescaline (San Pedro cactus) completely legal in Peru, Ecuador, Colombia. Retreat centers operate openly in Sacred Valley (Peru), Amazon, and coastal regions. Shamanic facilitation model (non-medical). Multi-day retreats (3-7 days) with preparation, ceremony, integration. Growing Western psychedelic retreat tourism.
eligibility_requirements: 18+, ability to travel. Psychological health screening by retreat (quality varies). No formal medical restrictions but high contraindications should apply (same as other psychedelics).
provider_requirements: Shaman/facilitator (NO medical licensing required). Retreat center operators. Variable training and experience. Some facilitators have years of experience, others minimal.
residency_travel_notes: Easy travel: most Westerners enter Peru/Ecuador/Colombia visa-free (tourist permit). Retreat centers in Lima, Sacred Valley, Cusco, Iquitos, Quito, Medellin. Weekly departures common (group ceremonies). Travel time to remote locations (rainforest) requires 1-2 days for acclimatization.
risk_notes: MAJOR RISKS: No medical oversight, facilitator credentials unknown, product potency/safety uncontrolled, no emergency medical protocols, remote locations far from advanced medical care, psychological screening inadequate, integration support minimal, no legal recourse if harm occurs, predatory operators documented (financial scams, sexual abuse). Requires extensive due diligence on specific retreat center.
oversight_notes: Virtually no government oversight in Peru/Ecuador. Retreat operators self-regulate (variable quality). No safety standards, no incident reporting, no credential verification. Legal risk for Western operators and facilitators varies by country.
cost_notes: Dramatically lower cost than psychotherapy clinics. Travel to South America adds $1,000-2,000. Accommodations often rustic (modest, clean centers available at lower cost; luxury retreats expensive). Retreat mid $1–3k (Andean/Amazon programs also common); travel $1–2k. Minimal medical oversight.
arbitrage_summary: Mescaline retreats in South America offer lowest-cost legal psychedelic experiences with facilitator guidance. HIGH RISK model—suitable only for individuals who have thoroughly vetted specific retreat operators, ideally through personal recommendations from prior attendees. NOT recommended for first-time psychedelic users.
